meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可帮你操作 git:先查看仓库状态和近期提交,自动判断提交消息的语言与风格;文件较多时把改动拆成多个小提交,按依赖顺序执行;也能做 rebase、squash 和查找某段代码何时加入。
howto.when: 当你提到 “commit”“rebase” 等 git 操作词,或询问某段代码是谁写的、何时加入时,该技能会接管。

say.text: 帮我把这次改动按目录拆成几个小提交,再依次提交。
say.note: Claude 会先输出提交计划,再逐个执行。

say.text: 把最近这三个提交合并成一个,并把说明改清楚。
say.note: 它会在非 main 分支执行 rebase/squash。

say.text: 查一下 pricing-table.tsx 里那行代码是谁加的。
say.note: 会运行 git blame 并给出提交信息。

howto.what_en: Claude handles git: inspects repo state and recent commits, detects message language/style, splits multi-file changes into atomic commits by dependency, and does rebase/squash or history searches.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', or ask who wrote a piece of code, when something was added, or which commit introduced it.

say_en.text: Split my changes into small commits by directory and commit them in order.
say_en.note: It outputs a plan, then executes the commits.

say_en.text: Squash these last three commits into one with a cleaner message.
say_en.note: Runs rebase/squash on a non-main branch.

say_en.text: Find who added that line in pricing-table.tsx.
say_en.note: Runs git blame and reports the commit.
